scope: ORL gray optimization, not full/exact paper reproduction
lda_dim_grid: paper anchor first, then 8,12,16,18,24,30,39 and available maximum; invalid dims removed
selection: highest validation correct count; ties retain first in declared iteration order

comparators.original_default: bilinear_pillow, center=False, paper dimensions, identity/3 CSA, Sw-normalized LDA + Euclidean, train-mean origin
comparators.plausible_fixed: bilinear_pillow, center=True, paper dimensions, identity/3 CSA, unit-column LDA + cosine, train-mean origin; hypothetical, not confirmed original
comparators.protocol_selected: validation selects unknown preprocessing/centering/init/scaling/metric/origin; paper pre/LDA dims and Tmax=3 fixed
comparators.grid_selected: validation selects protocol and bounded pre/LDA dimensions plus Tmax

limitations: Same 400 images have been explored previously. Test is held out within each new split, not a new untouched dataset; repeated splits overlap. Test results do not influence this frozen grid.
